steps.step: I1.(corrected) species = Cartan rank 5 + 3 = 8 complex (from P2 and the four marks); dim S+ = 16 is the complex D5 spinor, not the Majorana count
I2.c = 8 (one per level-one Cartan boson) is an output; equality with rank E8 is a consistency check only
I3.Nielsen-Ninomiya on all admissible seas: right movers = left movers; K3 <=> exactly one chiral mode per side
steps.detail: chiral content per side over 70 seas: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]; K3 = 'purely chiral seam' (axiom, no E8)

steps.step: I4.CAR fixes level one: N S^(m) = |m| exactly for |m| <= N/2 (integer charges)
I5.canonical 2 pi: (1/2pi) sum <rho rho>_m / m^2 e^{im th} = v484 |D|^-1 kernel -(1/pi) ln|2 sin(th/2)| (no free factor)
steps.detail: max dev at pi/2, pi, pi/3: 4.7e-04 (finite-N tail)
